# Ziiro AI

> Ziiro AI works in three stages for startups, solo founders and founder-led
> teams: Diagnose maps how the business actually runs and prices the
> opportunity, Build ships agents into the operation, and Optimize keeps them
> measured and tuned. We only build technology when the numbers prove it's
> worth it, and every engagement ships a working, measured system, not a
> slide deck.

The order is the product: understand the business, find the bottlenecks,
quantify the ROI, then build only what the numbers justify. We turn down work
when the math doesn't support it.

## Full content in one fetch

- [llms-full.txt](https://ziiro.work/llms-full.txt): every page below as markdown,
  generated at build time from the same prerendered HTML a crawler receives, so it
  cannot drift from the site. Fetch this instead of crawling the pages individually.

## Start here
- [Ziiro AI](https://ziiro.work): AI that has to pay for itself. The agent directory behind the work — the jobs, agents and departments we actually run — and the ask: an hourly consultation.
- [Book a Call](https://ziiro.work/book-a-call): The conversion page, and the only one that explains what happens IN the strategy session. A paid hourly session with a one hour minimum, booked through Calendly. Bring the work that consumes time, creates bottlenecks or feels unnecessarily manual, and leave with three things: priority opportunities where AI or automation may create the most leverage, rough ROI and effort sizing as an initial view of value against complexity, and one recommended next move. Contact is the separate quiet page for general inquiries, partnerships, press and questions before booking.
- [Contact](https://ziiro.work/contact): The quiet page for anything that is not a booking: a question, a partnership idea, or something you want us to look at. A message form with a reason field covering project inquiry, partnership, existing client, press and media, general question and other, plus the direct address, contact@ziiroai.com, and a usual reply inside 24 hours. Booking a session happens on Book a Call instead.

## Watch
- [How Ziiro works, in full](https://ziiro.work/watch/how-ziiro-works): An eight-minute screen-share walkthrough of the whole business in the order you'd actually ask about it: what we do and what we deliberately don't, how an engagement runs start to finish, what you invest and how scope gets set, and where your data goes and who can see it.

## What we do
- [Products](https://ziiro.work/products): What gets built, in three stages, and everything we make sits in one of them. Diagnose (operations map, KPI baselines, ROI models, role diagnostics, build roadmap; you leave with a roadmap and a spec, whether or not we build it). Build (workflow agents, research and enrichment, routing and follow-up, stack integration, dashboards and controls; you leave with a running system, the access to it and its documentation). Optimize (outcome tracking, test loops, auto-tuned campaigns, learning reports; you leave with a measurement cycle running on a cadence you agreed to).
- [Docs](https://ziiro.work/docs): The technical and methodological reference, in seven sections: Getting started, Engagement lifecycle (consult, diagnose, build, optimize), Diagnose methodology phase by phase with the frameworks and checklists used in each, Implementation, Technical architecture, Data and ownership, and FAQs. Written for someone who already understands what Ziiro does and now wants the detail.
- [Pricing](https://ziiro.work/pricing): One published rate for the hour, then a scope. The consultation is billed hourly with a one hour minimum; project work is quoted after it, one stage at a time, and there is no fixed project pricing and no menu. Diagnose (typical span 1 to 3 weeks), Build (4 to 12 weeks), Optimize (runs in cycles, not to a finish date).

## Who it's for
- SaaS and software startups, solo founders, founder-led agencies, consulting and professional services, and AI-first service businesses. Lean teams, roughly 5-500 people, that want measurable outcomes rather than AI for its own sake.

## Company
- [Who We Are](https://ziiro.work/who-we-are): Who you are actually hiring. A small business-intelligence-first AI consultancy for founder-led businesses: the origin story of why the company reverses the usual order and measures before it builds, Ziiro at a glance, and three differentiators (numbers first, built by the people who scope it, model agnostic). No individual names or photographs, deliberately.
- [Mission](https://ziiro.work/mission): Why the company exists and what it refuses to do. We don't sell AI, we sell results, and AI without business intelligence is expensive guessing. Five principles we work by, and four kinds of work we turn down: a build with no baseline, automation that moves a bottleneck instead of removing it, AI where arithmetic would do, and work the numbers don't support.
- [Careers](https://ziiro.work/careers): There are no open roles. Why the page is empty (a hire is a system and the numbers do not currently clear), an honest guess at what the first role would be when it opens, an operations analyst or a systems engineer, what earns a reply in the meantime, and the published address to write to. No application form and no applicant tracker.
- [FAQ](https://ziiro.work/faq): Every question the site answers, in one place, grouped as before you book, scope and timeline, and how we work. What the paid hour actually covers (opportunities ranked, rough sizing in hours back against effort, one recommended next move), that no data preparation or written brief is needed beforehand, that Ziiro is based in India and works with teams worldwide, how a project is scoped from that hour, typical spans of 1 to 3 weeks for Diagnose and 4 to 12 for Build, whether Diagnose is required before Build, what ongoing support is, what happens when the diagnosis says do not build, which models are used and why none of them is the advantage, and what systems access is needed. Questions the site cannot answer honestly yet are deliberately absent rather than guessed.

## Optional
- [Security and Trust](https://ziiro.work/security): How Ziiro designs, builds and runs systems that handle client data. NOT about this website. Written as engineering practice and per-engagement agreement rather than as certifications, because the tense is the honesty: how systems are designed is checkable in an engagement, while a claim about every running environment is not. AI and model security is the centre: approved providers only, minimum necessary context rather than whole datasets, redaction or tokenisation before a prompt leaves the system, a position on provider training stated per provider because providers differ, logical isolation of one client's prompts, files and vector indexes from another's with NO global semantic search across clients, prompt injection treated as a given so retrieved content never inherits privileged authority and system instruction, client instruction, retrieved content and tool permission stay separated, scoped tool permissions so an agent that reads email does not gain permission to send it, human approval for irreversible or externally visible actions, and deterministic validation of model output before it is written to a business-critical system. The model is one component; permission, context, validation, logging, business rules and human control live in the system around it. Also: data isolation and tenancy with no cross-client analytics or pooling for our own training, scoped credentials and revocation, transport and storage design, logging and incident procedure, resilience and exit handover. Regulated workloads including health data: administrative, technical and physical safeguards described, running only under an agreed configuration with the necessary agreements in place and only through services contracted and configured for that data. NOT established and explicitly not claimed: SOC 2, ISO 27001, any independent penetration test or audit, internal MFA enforcement, access reviews, a rehearsed incident runbook, continuous monitoring, tested restores. A BAA IS available for qualifying healthcare engagements, under stated conditions: the engagement is an approved HIPAA-regulated one, Ziiro is genuinely acting as a business associate, and every downstream subprocessor touching the data is itself contracted and configured for it. There is no generic HIPAA certification, so none is claimed or implied and the page marks that item Not applicable. Controls scale with what the engagement touches, from public material through internal operations and confidential third-party material to regulated categories, with specifics set in the engagement contract.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ziiro.work/privacy): What we collect, how we use it, and how to have it deleted. Your numbers are never sold or passed on.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://ziiro.work/terms): Terms governing use of the site and services, including AI outputs and liability limits.
